# Balinjera Restaurant

> Kosher Ethiopian restaurant in Kerem HaTeimanim, next to Carmel Market in Tel Aviv, Israel, specializing in fresh teff injera and shared Ethiopian meals.

Balinjera (באלינג'רה) serves traditional Ethiopian and Ethiopian-Jewish food at Malan 4 / HaKovshim 39 in Kerem HaTeimanim, near Carmel Market. The site is bilingual: Hebrew is the default RTL experience, and English LTR pages are available with the `?lang=en` query parameter.

Important details:

- Cuisine: Traditional Ethiopian, specializing in injera (אינג'רה) made fresh from teff flour
- Kosher: kosher certificate from the Rabanut Tel Aviv (Regila standard); a meat restaurant with no dairy products on the premises
- Menu: vegan injera platters and stews alongside meat dishes such as tibs, doro wat and siga wat (current prices on the menu page)
- Hours: Sunday–Thursday 12:00–20:00, Friday 11:00–15:00, Saturday closed. Holiday hours may differ: see the site footer or call.
- Phone: 03-525-2527
- Email: fantaprada25@gmail.com
- Last updated: 2026-09-29

- [Is injera gluten-free?](https://www.balinjera.com/blog/injera-gluten-free): Teff, wheat and what to check.
- [What is buna?](https://www.balinjera.com/blog/ethiopian-coffee-buna): Ethiopian coffee, by the cup or in a pot.
